title: Episodic looking - using reinforcement learning to bias perception enhances few-shot and continual learning with protection from forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2610.38577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There is a fundamental contradiction between the desire for models that can generalize, and models that can continuously adapt to recent input with changing statistics. These conditions, captured in few-shot and continual learning settings, can bias or disrupt learned representations. This harms generalization to a broader context, leaving the model unable to overcome input variance.   This paper proposes a solution based on the Complementary Learning System architecture (CLS), in which a Short-Term Memory (STM) delegates generalization to a slow, statistical Long-Term Memory (LTM). Delegation is achieved by working in a space of robust, generalized perceptions produced by the LTM. With this separation, the STM can focus on memorizing recent input and avoiding interference between memories.   We show that on an image classification task, the resulting CLS model is more resistant to forgetting in a domain-incremental continual learning

translated_title: 情景式观察——利用强化学习偏置感知以增强少样本学习和持续学习并防止遗忘
translated_abstract: 模型对泛化能力的需求与模型持续适应统计特性不断变化的近期输入之间存在根本性矛盾。少样本学习和持续学习场景所体现的这些条件可能会偏置或破坏已学习的表征，从而损害模型对更广泛上下文的泛化能力，使模型无法克服输入方差的影响。本文提出了一种基于互补学习系统架构的解决方案，其中短期记忆将泛化任务委托给缓慢的、统计性的长期记忆。这种委托是通过在由长期记忆产生的鲁棒且泛化的感知空间中工作来实现的。通过这种分离，短期记忆可以专注于记忆近期输入并避免记忆之间的相互干扰。我们证明，在图像分类任务中，由此产生的CLS模型在域增量持续学习中具有更强的抗遗忘能力。
tldr: 该论文提出基于互补学习系统（CLS）架构的方法，利用强化学习偏置感知，让短期记忆在长期记忆产生的泛化感知空间中工作并专注于记忆近期输入，从而在增强少样本学习和持续学习能力的同时有效防止遗忘。
